name: Input
purpose: Collects a single line of text with label, disabled, and invalid states.
scenarios: Enter a project or user name
Show a validation error beside the field
Disable the field while a request is in flight

label.description: Visible accessible name for the text box.

invalid.description: Marks the control invalid and shows error text.

errorMessage.description: Message shown when invalid is true.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Failed validation; error text is shown.

antiPatterns: Do not use a placeholder as the only label.
Do not announce errors only by color.

a11y.focus: Visible focus ring; label remains associated in LTR and RTL.

responsive.strategy: The field stretches to the inline size of its container. Target height stays at least 44px.

breakpoints.compact: Full inline size of the parent.

rtl.strategy: Logical padding and borders. Text value direction follows the document lang/dir.
